description:
Found s504 by s501t: t/op/magic.t row #66 (`print $? & 0xFF ? "ok $tn[4]" : "not ok $tn[4]"` after a child that kills itself with SIGINT) became a NUMBERED `not ok` once `tie my @tn` worked (#155); under main the same line printed an unnumbered `not ok` (the untied @tn gave no number).  PRE-EXISTING: same answer on main b7ec0093.

Reproducer (perl prints `status=2 sig=2`; PCL prints `status=512 sig=0`, on main and on the s501t tree):
    open(CMDPIPE, "|-", "perl") or die;
    print CMDPIPE '$SIG{INT} = "DEFAULT"; kill "INT", $$; sleep 1;';
    close CMDPIPE;
    printf "status=%d sig=%d\n", $?, $? & 0xFF;

`system(LIST)` is right (s501t probe: a PCL or perl child killed by SIGINT gives sig=2), so it is the piped-open CLOSE path that converts the wait status -- most likely it waits through a shell or reads the process's exit CODE (128+N folded, or SBCL's process-exit-code) instead of the raw wait status.  Layer: runtime (close of a pipe handle); sibling of #2101 (backticks $?), #1770.  Guard: a Pl/t row with the reproducer above.

=== s543c (Opus 5.5, 2026-11-21, CODE 64353611) ===
VERDICT: LIVE -- as filed, and the READ pipe too (silent):
    "|-" to a perl child that kills itself with SIGINT, then close:   perl status=2 sig=2        PCL status=512 sig=0
    "-|" from `sh -c 'kill -TERM $$'`, then close:                    perl status=15 sig=15      PCL status=3840 sig=0
  `system(LIST)` of the same -> sig=2 in both (right).
LABEL: silent (already in the subject).

=== DONE (s543n, Opus 5.5, 2026-11-24; WIP 3 e355be6d) ===
The conversion that was wrong was not the pipe close's: it stores waitpid's RAW status already.  The child it waits
for is PCL's EMULATED exec (%p-exec-become -- SBCL cannot replace its image, so the forked child runs the program and
waits), which exited with SBCL's process-exit-code -- for a signal death that IS the signal number, so the close read
SIG << 8.  %p-exec-become now reads the program's wait status through %p-process-wait-status (system's and
backticks' one reading) and, for a signal, takes the signal's default action (%p-sig-die-by-default); an exit code is
exited with.  All four paths now agree: system (was right), backticks (was right), a pipe close and a fork+exec+waitpid
(fixed), a signal sent to a PCL fork child (right already: #1770's signal face).
Probe scratch/s543n/probes/pC2.pl (13 rows: `|-` INT, `-|` LIST TERM / KILL / QUIT, exit 3 / 0, the shell string,
`yes` killed by PIPE when the reader closes -- no hang --, close twice, the fork-open, system INT, backticks TERM):
perl = tree except `${^CHILD_ERROR_NATIVE}` (unsupported, base too: filed #5421).  Guard Pl/t/system-block-01.t
row 51 (FAILS on the base).
